system.description: • Effect: Whenever a Kit ability's exact effect is left open to GM adjudication (Infuse Item's chosen property, Quickbuild Gadget's specific effect, and similar), it always includes at minimum a flat +1 bonus per 4 Artificer levels (minimum +1) to whatever check or save it affects, or base damage/healing of 1d6 per 4 levels (minimum 1d6) if the effect is damaging or restorative. This is a floor, not a cap — a generous GM ruling can always exceed it, but it never falls below this baseline.
